evidence: A comparison of the nucleation stage of the films on OH- and H-terminated Si surfaces has been performed using Rutherford backscattering spectrometry, x-ray photoelectron spectroscopy /XPS/, and spectroscopic ellipsometry /SE/. ... The SE and the AFM data are consistent with higher porosity for the films on H-terminated surfaces. ... The interfacial layer thickness was determined using ARXPS and HRTEM. ... The film thickness was measured by a spectroscopic ellipsometer. ... Atomic force microscopy /AFM/ measurements reveal higher surface roughness for the films deposited in the H-terminated surface. ... The data for each film were fitted to a simple linear function and the best lines are plotted for each data set with the derived interfacial layer thickness d shown on the plot. ... The film thickness was measured using SE for films deposited on both chemical oxide and H-terminated Si. ... The surface roughness of the films was examined using atomic force microscopy. ... The interfacial layer thickness analysis performed with the ARXPS measurements and the HRTEM data.
